en.hubeali: ‘He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘The one who mentions Allah<sup>azwj</sup> Mighty and Majestic upon the meal would not be Questioned about that Bounty, ever!’
en.sarwar: 6. Through the same chain of narrators as that of the previous Hadith

the following is narrated: “He (the Imam), ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ’One who mentions the name of Allah, most Majestic, most Glorious, on food, he will never be asked any questions about that blessing.’”
